items.abstract: <jats:p>The trade in human remains on social media happens in an ever-changing field of digital media technologies. We attempt to replicate our earlier study, exploring the differences in what we can observe now in the trade on Instagram versus our first foray in 2016 (published in Huffer and Graham 2017). While the previous study cannot be reproduced, it can be replicated, and we find that the trade is accelerating.</jats:p>
title: Reproducibility, Replicability, and Revisiting the Insta-Dead and the Human Remains Trade
